objectives.en: I can describe my daily routine with phrases like wake up, get dressed and have breakfast.
objectives.he: אני יכול/ה לתאר את סדר היום שלי בעזרת צירופים כמו wake up, get dressed ו-have breakfast.

objectives.en: I can say how often I do things with always, usually, often, sometimes and never.
objectives.he: אני יכול/ה לומר באיזו תדירות אני עושה דברים בעזרת always, usually, often, sometimes ו-never.

objectives.en: I can put these words in the right place: before the main verb, but after am/is/are.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת איפה לשים את המילים האלה: לפני הפועל הראשי, אבל אחרי am/is/are.

warmup.en: What do you do every morning before you leave home? Think of three things, in order. Do you do them every day, or only on some days?
warmup.he: מה אתם עושים כל בוקר לפני שאתם יוצאים מהבית? חשבו על שלושה דברים, לפי הסדר. אתם עושים אותם כל יום, או רק בחלק מהימים? היום נלמד לומר את זה באנגלית.

explanation.en: Omer always wakes up at 6:30, but he usually gets up at 6:45. He often has a shower in the evening, and he never has breakfast at home. Words like always and never tell us how often something happens.
explanation.he: עומר תמיד מתעורר ב-6:30, אבל בדרך כלל קם רק ב-6:45. הוא הרבה פעמים מתקלח בערב, ואף פעם לא אוכל ארוחת בוקר בבית. מילים כמו always ו-never אומרות באיזו תדירות משהו קורה.

rows: I always brush my teeth before bed.

explanation.en: The frequency word goes before the main verb: I usually get up at seven. She never drinks coffee. But it goes after am/is/are: I'm always tired. The bus is often late.
explanation.he: מילת התדירות באה לפני הפועל הראשי: I usually get up at seven, She never drinks coffee. אבל עם am/is/are היא באה אחרי הפועל: I'm always tired, The bus is often late.

explanation.en: Never is already negative, so don't add don't: I never eat breakfast (not 'I don't never eat'). And keep the -s after he/she/it: She usually gets up early.
explanation.he: never כבר שלילי, ולכן לא מוסיפים don't: I never eat breakfast, ולא I don't never eat. ואחרי he/she/it ה-s נשארת גם כשמילת התדירות באמצע: She usually gets up early.

explanation.en: Sometimes and usually can also start a sentence: Sometimes I work from home. To ask about frequency, use How often...? – How often do you go to the gym? – Usually three times a week.
explanation.he: את sometimes ו-usually אפשר לשים גם בתחילת המשפט: Sometimes I work from home. כדי לשאול 'כל כמה זמן?' אומרים How often...? – How often do you go to the gym? – Usually three times a week.

examples.en: My sister usually gets up late on Saturdays.
examples.he: אחותי בדרך כלל קמה מאוחר בשבתות.
אנחנו הרבה פעמים אוכלים ארוחת בוקר ביחד.

examples.en: I never drink coffee in the evening.
examples.he: אני אף פעם לא שותה קפה בערב.

examples.en: Maya is always tired on Monday mornings.
examples.he: מאיה תמיד עייפה בימי שני בבוקר.

examples.en: How often do you go to the gym? – Usually three times a week.
examples.he: כל כמה זמן את/ה הולך/ת לחדר כושר? – בדרך כלל שלוש פעמים בשבוע.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew the present-tense verb works differently: it is the same for 'I' and 'he' (both use one form). So it is easy to forget the English -s, especially when a word comes between: She usually gets up at seven (not 'She usually get up').
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית הפועל בהווה זהה ל'אני' ול'הוא' (אני קם, הוא קם), ולכן קל לשכוח את ה-s באנגלית, במיוחד כשיש מילה באמצע: She usually gets up at seven, ולא She usually get up.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew there is no present-tense 'be', so 'She always tired' can sound right. English needs is, and the frequency word comes after it: She is always tired.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין 'להיות' בהווה ('היא תמיד עייפה'), ולכן She always tired נשמע אולי נכון. באנגלית חייבים is, ומילת התדירות באה אחריו: She is always tired.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: Hebrew has one 'i' vowel, but English has a short /ɪ/ and a long /iː/, so leave /liːv/ and live /lɪv/ can sound the same. I leave home at eight (long) is different from I live at home (short).
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית יש תנועת 'אִי' אחת, ובאנגלית שתיים: קצרה /ɪ/ וארוכה /iː/. לכן leave ו-live עלולות להישמע אותו דבר. I leave home at eight (ארוכה – 'יוצא/ת מהבית') שונה מ-I live at home (קצרה – 'גר/ה בבית').

prompt.en: Match each routine phrase with its Hebrew meaning.
prompt.he: התאימו כל צירוף מסדר היום למשמעות שלו בעברית.

pairs: לנסוע כל יום לעבודה או ללימודים

explanation.en: Learn these as whole phrases. English often uses have for meals and showers: have breakfast, have a shower. And go to bed has no 'the'.
explanation.he: כדאי ללמוד אותם כצירופים שלמים. שימו לב: באנגלית משתמשים ב-have לארוחות ולמקלחת (have breakfast, have a shower), וב-go to bed אין the.

prompt.en: Put the words in order, from 100% to 0%.

hint.en: Start with the word that means 'every time'.

explanation.en: always (100%) → usually (about 90%) → often (about 70%) → sometimes (about 40%) → never (0%).
explanation.he: always (תמיד, 100%) → usually (בדרך כלל) → often (הרבה פעמים) → sometimes (לפעמים) → never (אף פעם לא, 0%).

prompt.en: Listen and choose the true sentence.

exercises.audio_text: I usually get up at seven, but I never have breakfast.
exercises.question: Which sentence is true?
options: The speaker always gets up at seven.

0.en: The speaker says usually, not always: on most days, but not every day.
0.he: הדובר/ת אומר/ת usually ולא always – ברוב הימים, אבל לא בכל יום.

2.en: Listen again: 'I never have breakfast' – not on any day.
2.he: הקשיבו שוב: 'I never have breakfast' – אף פעם, באף יום.

explanation.en: usually = most days; never = not on any day. The speaker usually gets up at seven and never has breakfast.
explanation.he: usually = ברוב הימים; never = אף פעם. הדובר/ת קם/ה בדרך כלל בשבע ואף פעם לא אוכל/ת ארוחת בוקר.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I get always up at seven.
Always I get up at seven.
I always get up at seven.
I get up always at seven.

0.en: get up is one verb. Don't split it: always comes before the whole verb, always get up.
0.he: get up הוא פועל אחד, ולא מפרקים אותו: always בא לפני הפועל כולו – always get up.

1.en: Always doesn't start a sentence like this. Put it before the verb: I always get up.
1.he: always לא פותח משפט כזה. שימו אותו לפני הפועל: I always get up.

3.en: Put always before the main verb, not after it: I always get up.
3.he: always בא לפני הפועל הראשי, לא אחריו: I always get up.

explanation.en: Subject + frequency word + main verb: I always get up at seven.
explanation.he: נושא + מילת תדירות + הפועל הראשי: I always get up at seven.

prompt.en: Is each sentence correct or wrong?
prompt.he: האם כל משפט נכון או שגוי?

items.text: My dad usually gets up at six.
My dad gets usually up at six.

explanation.en: Three rules: the frequency word goes before the main verb (never eat, usually gets up); after be (is always tired), and be can't be dropped; he/she/it keeps the -s (often walks).
explanation.he: שלושה כללים: מילת התדירות לפני הפועל הראשי (never eat, usually gets up); אחרי be (is always tired), ואסור להשמיט את is; ועם he/she/it ה-s נשארת (often walks).

prompt.en: Use the words in brackets. Put them in the right order and use the right verb form.
prompt.he: השתמשו במילים שבסוגריים. סדרו אותן נכון והשתמשו בצורת הפועל הנכונה.

exercises.text: Maya ___ (usually / go) to work by bike, but on rainy days she ___ (sometimes / get) the bus.

feedback.en: Maya = she, so the verb needs -es: usually goes.
feedback.he: מאיה היא she, ולכן הפועל מקבל es: usually goes.

feedback.en: Put usually before the verb: usually goes.
feedback.he: usually בא לפני הפועל: usually goes.

feedback.en: Put sometimes before the verb here: she sometimes gets the bus.
feedback.he: כאן sometimes בא לפני הפועל: she sometimes gets the bus.

hint.en: Maya and she → verb + s. The frequency word comes first.
hint.he: מאיה ו-she → פועל עם s. מילת התדירות באה ראשונה.

explanation.en: Frequency word + verb, and the -s stays: Maya usually goes to work by bike; she sometimes gets the bus. (get the bus = take the bus)
explanation.he: מילת תדירות + פועל, וה-s נשארת: Maya usually goes; she sometimes gets the bus. (get the bus = לנסוע באוטובוס)

prompt.en: Add the word in brackets: before the main verb, or after am/is/are.
prompt.he: הוסיפו את המילה שבסוגריים: לפני הפועל הראשי, או אחרי am/is/are.

feedback.en: With am/is/are, the frequency word comes after: is never late.
feedback.he: עם am/is/are מילת התדירות באה אחרי: is never late.

feedback.en: never doesn't go at the end. Put it after is: is never late.
feedback.he: never לא בא בסוף המשפט. שימו אותו אחרי is: is never late.

feedback.en: never is already negative, so don't add not: is never late.
feedback.he: never כבר שלילי, ולכן לא מוסיפים not: is never late.

explanation.en: is is a form of be, so never comes after it: My boss is never late.
explanation.he: is הוא צורה של be, ולכן never בא אחריו: My boss is never late.

prompt.en: Add the word in brackets: before the main verb, or after am/is/are.
prompt.he: הוסיפו את המילה שבסוגריים: לפני הפועל הראשי, או אחרי am/is/are.

exercises.source: Daniel uses his phone in bed. (often)
answers: Daniel often uses his phone in bed.

wrong_feedback.match: Daniel uses often his phone in bed.

feedback.en: Don't put often between the verb and its object. Put it before the verb: often uses.
feedback.he: לא שמים את often בין הפועל למה שבא אחריו. שימו אותו לפני הפועל: often uses.

wrong_feedback.match: Daniel often use his phone in bed.

feedback.en: Daniel = he, so keep the -s: often uses.
feedback.he: דניאל הוא he, ולכן ה-s נשארת: often uses.

explanation.en: uses is the main verb, so often goes before it: Daniel often uses his phone in bed.
explanation.he: uses הוא הפועל הראשי, ולכן often בא לפניו: Daniel often uses his phone in bed.

prompt.en: This sentence has a mistake. Write it correctly.
prompt.he: במשפט יש טעות. כתבו אותו נכון.

explanation.en: English uses one negative word, not two: I never eat breakfast. (I don't ever eat breakfast is also correct.)
explanation.he: באנגלית יש מילת שלילה אחת בלבד, לא שתיים: I never eat breakfast. (גם I don't ever eat breakfast נכון.)

exercises.sentence: My brother usually go to bed at midnight.
answers: My brother usually goes to bed at midnight.

explanation.en: My brother = he, so the verb takes -es: goes. The frequency word in the middle doesn't change that.
explanation.he: My brother הוא he, ולכן הפועל מקבל es: goes. מילת התדירות באמצע לא משנה את זה.

answers: She is always tired in the morning.
She is always tired in the mornings.
In the morning she is always tired.
In the morning, she is always tired.

wrong_feedback.match: She always tired in the morning.

feedback.en: The Hebrew sentence has no verb, but English needs is: She is always tired.
feedback.he: במשפט בעברית אין פועל, אבל באנגלית חייבים is: She is always tired.

wrong_feedback.match: She always is tired in the morning.

feedback.en: With is, the frequency word comes after it: She is always tired.
feedback.he: עם is מילת התדירות באה אחריו: She is always tired.

wrong_feedback.match: She is tired always in the morning.

feedback.en: Put always right after is: She is always tired.
feedback.he: שימו את always מיד אחרי is: She is always tired.

wrong_feedback.match: She is always tired at the morning.

feedback.en: Good grammar! Just one small word: we say in the morning.
feedback.he: הדקדוק נכון! רק מילה אחת: אומרים in the morning.

hint.en: You need is. Then: where does always go?
hint.he: צריך is. ואיפה שמים את always?

explanation.en: English needs be here, and always comes after it: She is always tired in the morning.
explanation.he: באנגלית חייבים כאן be, ו-always בא אחריו: She is always tired in the morning.

prompt.en: Read Kenji's blog post and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את הפוסט של קנג'י בבלוג וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: A day in my life
exercises.passage: I'm Kenji, and I'm a student at the university in Haifa. My weekdays are busy. I always wake up at 6:30, but I usually get up at 6:45! I have a shower and get dressed. I never have breakfast at home – I buy coffee at the station. I commute by train, and it is often late, so I sometimes study on the platform. I usually get home at six. In the evening I cook dinner with my flatmate, Amir. I go to bed at eleven, but Amir never goes to bed before one!

explanation.en: 'I never have breakfast at home – I buy coffee at the station.'
explanation.he: 'I never have breakfast at home' – הוא אף פעם לא אוכל ארוחת בוקר בבית; הוא קונה קפה בתחנה.

explanation.en: 'I always wake up at 6:30, but I usually get up at 6:45.' He always wakes up at 6:30, but usually gets up later.
explanation.he: 'I always wake up at 6:30, but I usually get up at 6:45' – הוא תמיד מתעורר ב-6:30, אבל בדרך כלל קם רק ב-6:45.

questions.question: Why does Kenji sometimes study on the platform?
options: Because his train is often late.

1.en: He never has breakfast at home, but that is not the reason. Look at the word so.
1.he: נכון שהוא לא אוכל ארוחת בוקר בבית, אבל זו לא הסיבה. חפשו את המילה so.

2.en: The text doesn't say Amir is noisy.

explanation.en: 'It is often late, so I sometimes study on the platform.' so introduces the result.
explanation.he: 'It is often late, so I sometimes study on the platform' – הרכבת מאחרת הרבה, ולכן הוא לפעמים לומד ברציף.

questions.question: Who goes to bed later?
options: They go to bed at the same time.

0.en: Kenji goes to bed at eleven. Amir never goes to bed before one.
0.he: קנג'י הולך לישון באחת עשרה. עמיר אף פעם לא הולך לישון לפני אחת.

2.en: Kenji: eleven. Amir: never before one. So not the same time.
2.he: קנג'י: באחת עשרה. עמיר: אף פעם לא לפני אחת. אז לא באותה שעה.

explanation.en: 'Amir never goes to bed before one' – so he always goes to bed at one or later.
explanation.he: 'Amir never goes to bed before one' – כלומר הוא תמיד הולך לישון באחת או מאוחר יותר.

questions.statement: Kenji and Amir cook dinner together.

explanation.en: 'In the evening I cook dinner with my flatmate, Amir.'
explanation.he: 'In the evening I cook dinner with my flatmate, Amir' – בערב הם מבשלים ארוחת ערב יחד.

prompt.en: Listen and type what you hear.

exercises.audio_text: We usually have dinner together, and my dad is always hungry.
answers: We usually have dinner together, and my dad is always hungry.

hint.en: Listen for two frequency words: one before a verb, one after is.
hint.he: הקשיבו לשתי מילות תדירות: אחת לפני פועל ואחת אחרי is.

explanation.en: usually comes before the verb (usually have), and always comes after is (is always hungry).
explanation.he: usually בא לפני הפועל (usually have), ו-always בא אחרי is (is always hungry).

exercises.target: I usually leave home at eight, and I never get home before six.

focus.en: leave has a long vowel /iː/, like 'leeeve'. With a short vowel it becomes live (= to have your home somewhere).
focus.he: ב-leave התנועה ארוכה /iː/ ('לִייב'). בתנועה קצרה היא הופכת ל-live ('לגור').

explanation.en: This is a sentence you can really use to describe your day. Long /iː/ in leave keeps your meaning clear.
explanation.he: זה משפט שאפשר באמת להשתמש בו כדי לתאר את היום שלכם. התנועה הארוכה ב-leave שומרת על המשמעות ברורה.

prompt.he: כתבו על יום חול רגיל שלכם.

task.en: Describe a typical weekday in 5-7 sentences: what you do and how often. Use at least four different frequency words (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) and at least one sentence with am/is/are + a frequency word (for example: I'm always tired on Sundays).
task.he: תארו יום חול רגיל ב-5-7 משפטים: מה אתם עושים ובאיזו תדירות. השתמשו לפחות בארבע מילות תדירות שונות (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) ובלפחות משפט אחד עם am/is/are ומילת תדירות (למשל: I'm always tired on Sundays).

exercises.model_answer: On weekdays I always wake up at 6:30. I usually have a shower and get dressed quickly. I never have breakfast at home, because I'm never hungry in the morning. I commute to work by bus, and the bus is often late. I sometimes listen to podcasts on the bus. I usually get home at six, and I go to bed at eleven.

checklist.en: The frequency word is before the main verb: I usually get up...
checklist.he: מילת התדירות באה לפני הפועל הראשי: I usually get up...

checklist.en: After am/is/are, the frequency word comes after: I'm always tired.
checklist.he: עם am/is/are, מילת התדירות באה אחרי: I'm always tired.

checklist.en: No don't with never: I never eat..., not I don't never eat...
checklist.he: אין don't עם never: I never eat, ולא I don't never eat.

checklist.en: If I write about he or she, the verb has -s: My sister usually gets up late.
checklist.he: כשאני כותב/ת על he או she, לפועל יש s: My sister usually gets up late.

key_points.he: always (תמיד) → usually (בדרך כלל) → often (הרבה פעמים) → sometimes (לפעמים) → never (אף פעם לא).

key_points.en: Before the main verb: I usually get up at seven. After am/is/are: I'm always tired.
key_points.he: לפני הפועל הראשי: I usually get up at seven. אחרי am/is/are: I'm always tired.

key_points.en: never is already negative: I never eat breakfast (no don't).
key_points.he: never כבר שלילי: I never eat breakfast (בלי don't).

key_points.en: Routine phrases: wake up, get up, get dressed, have a shower, have breakfast, leave home, commute, get home, go to bed.
key_points.he: צירופים לסדר היום: wake up, get up, get dressed, have a shower, have breakfast, leave home, commute, get home, go to bed.
